messages:
Alice: Quick recap from last night — rooftop pickup final: Team Pineapple 4, Team Anchovy 3. Evan hat-trick. Highlight clip: https://short.link/clip1 :soccer:
Ben: Evan is unhinged :joy: that volley at 2:17 was insane
Evan: lol that was literally off my shin guard tbh. I'll accept the glory. Where's the pizza tab? :pizza:
Carlos: Also — fantasy semifinals this Sunday. Any veto drama? I'm trying to trade for Mira's striker. @Deepa are you running trade approvals?
Deepa: Yep, trade window closes Sat 6pm. I already rejected a weird 2-for-1 that was basically a meme. Rule reminder: no IR-dump trades, and don’t trade to circumvent lineup limits.
Alice: Also planning a watch party for the semis. Can we do a quick snack sign-up? I’ll bring sodas. @snack-bot can you add "chips" to the list?
snack-bot: Snack list updated — chips (Alice). Current suggestions: pizza?, wings?. Reply with `claim: item` to add yourself.
Ben: claim: wings
Evan: claim: pizza (small). Also I can free up 2 parking spots in the south lot for guests.
Carlos: FYI I’m benching two midfielders for attacking subs in fantasy. If anyone wants to protest my managerial genius, DM me :smile: 
Deepa: Minor housekeeping: rooftop noise please <11pm — building management asked. Also please use the provided trash bags after the party. :sweat_smile:
Evan: Afterparty at The Nook? low-key MVP toast for whoever wins the fantasy semis :beers:
